clips.title: The story
paras: The Shipping Label is a recovered freight marker attached to a supply crate owned by the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Directing couriers to their trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains, it introduces travelers to the organization's network of independent haulers.

Found pasted to a stocked supply crate, this damaged shipping label marks cargo belonging to the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Although the intended destination and recipient have been torn away, clear instructions direct anyone who discovers the freight to return it or report to the authority's trade outpost in the Redridge Mountains. Beside the formal text, a rudimentary map sketches out the roads leading toward the Three Corners intersection.

At the crossroads of Three Corners, representatives of the Azeroth Commerce Authority actively enlist travelers as independent couriers. Rather than binding haulers to strict merchant contracts, the authority operates an informal network where adventurers are compensated with Merchant's Favor in return for recovering missing cargo and fulfilling abandoned deliveries along the highway.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."
Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.
When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.
Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
